<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_Incident" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/incident">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_IncidentReport" name="Incident report" />
  <bpmn:process id="Process_IncidentHandling" name="Handle incident" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_IncidentReported" name="Incident reported">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_IncidentReport" messageRef="Message_IncidentReport" />
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_LogIncident" name="Log incident in tracking system" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssignTeam" name="Assign report to appropriate team" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherInformation" name="Gather necessary information" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IdentifyCause" name="Identify incident cause" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProposeActions" name="Propose corrective actions" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ImplementSolution" name="Implement solution" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FollowUp" name="Conduct follow-up to ensure non-recurrence" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CloseReport" name="Close incident report" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NotifyStakeholders" name="Notify all stakeholders" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_IncidentClosed" name="Incident report closed and stakeholders notified" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_IncidentReported" targetRef="Task_LogIncident" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_LogIncident" targetRef="Task_AssignTeam" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_AssignTeam" targetRef="Task_GatherInformation" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_GatherInformation" targetRef="Task_IdentifyCause" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_IdentifyCause" targetRef="Task_ProposeActions" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_ProposeActions" targetRef="Task_ImplementSolution" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_ImplementSolution" targetRef="Task_FollowUp" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_FollowUp" targetRef="Task_CloseReport" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Task_CloseReport" targetRef="Task_NotifyStakeholders" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_NotifyStakeholders" targetRef="EndEvent_IncidentClosed" />
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Incident">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_IncidentReporter" name="Employee or customer" />
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_IncidentProcess" name="Incident handling process" processRef="Process_IncidentHandling" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_IncidentReport" name="Incident report" sourceRef="Participant_IncidentReporter" targetRef="StartEvent_IncidentReported" messageRef="Message_IncidentReport" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
